segments.text: I have been spending millions of dollars for the past 3 years working to slow my speed of Aging today I'm going to show you one of my favorite meals called super veggie it's a delicious way to get so many of your vegetables chef Jamie is going to show you how you can prepare it in 20 minutes time I eat this every day and it's one of my most favorite moments First Take cauliflower for anti-inflammatory and fiber do the same with your broccoli measure out 50 g of either shitaki or maake mushrooms one peeled clove of garlic and 3 G of Ginger boil the broccoli cauliflower and mushrooms together for 7 to 9 minutes

until fairly soft the base of your super veggie will be 150 g of cooked black lentils take your boiled broccoli cauliflower and mushrooms and add them to your base of lentils add 1 tbsp of cumin 1 tbsp of hemp seeds add the chopped ginger and garlic add 1 tbsp of apple cider vinegar I also add 1 tblspoon of extra virgin olive oil you've now completed super veggie good job
